title: Supporter Pack release

cards.title: Supporter Pack
cards.body:
*The Supporter Pack* is an optional one-time purchase, no subscription, that unlocks extra features and helps fund development.

What you get:
- Promotional tabs on store catalogs, including PC Game Pass library
- Release calendar across Steam, Epic and Game Pass
- New themes, starting with Wall, plus every theme added later
- A different theme for each catalog
- More focus colors for grid tiles and menus
- Controller shortcut to jump back to Shift from a game or the desktop
- New perks as they ship, at no extra cost

cards.title: Release Calendar
cards.body: *Release Calendar* (Supporter Pack). View upcoming games from Steam and Epic, grouped by week, month or year, with Steam’s most anticipated rank, Early Access and Free to Play badges, and a short trailer on the game in focus.

cards.title: Wall theme
cards.body:
*Wall theme* (Supporter Pack). A full-screen wall of covers tilted back in 3D, one row per tab, each row scrolling on its own.
2 types of effect and an option to make it infinite vertically. Adjust it to your liking.

cards.title: Freedom of colors
cards.body: *Focus color editor* (Supporter Pack). Press A on Grid tile or Menu focus color in Settings > Visuals to recolor any preset with Hue, Saturation and Brightness or a hex code.

cards.title: Power menu
cards.body: *Power menu* (sleep, restart, shutdown, etc). Click the left stick (L3) from anywhere in Shift, or click its hint at the bottom left.

cards.title: Automatic updates
cards.body: *Automatic updates* for the GitHub version. Turn the download off or check by hand in Settings > Info > Software update. The Microsoft Store version keeps updating through the Store.

changelog: New: *Supporter Pack*, a one-time unlock for extras, in Settings > Info > Supporter Pack.

New: *Release Calendar* (Supporter Pack). Upcoming games from Steam and Epic, grouped by week, month or year, with Steam’s most anticipated rank, Early Access and Free to Play badges, and a short trailer on the game in focus.
New: *Wall theme* (Supporter Pack). A full-screen wall of covers tilted back in 3D, one row per tab, each row scrolling on its own.
New: *Focus color editor* (Supporter Pack). Press A on Grid tile or Menu focus color in Settings > Visuals to recolor any preset with Hue, Saturation and Brightness or a hex code.
New: *Power menu* (sleep, restart, shutdown, etc). Click the left stick (L3) from anywhere in Shift, or click its hint at the bottom left.
New: *Automatic updates* for the GitHub version. Turn the download off or check by hand in Settings > Info > Software update. The Microsoft Store version keeps updating through the Store.

Moving into the Supporter Pack: browsing Game Pass in the Xbox catalog, per-catalog themes, focus colors beyond the five free presets for grid tiles and for menus, custom backgrounds, the controller focus shortcut, the Promos tab in the Epic catalog and the Deals tab in the GOG catalog. Your own Xbox library (the Not installed tab) stays free, and nothing you set up is deleted: unlocking brings it all back as it was.
Added Open/install in EA app button for EA Play games in the Game Pass catalog.
Added NVIDIA app, Intel Graphics Software and AMD Software: Adrenalin Edition show up in Tools when installed. Several tools also got their own logo.
Shift now runs borderless fullscreen instead of maximized, so the taskbar no longer shows on the desktop.
Restart app moved from Settings > General to the power menu, as Restart Shift.
Some improvements on the installer for the GitHub version.
The Xbox sign-in page opens right away, and notifications use your menu focus color and slide in from the bottom.
Applied virtualization on themes, so moving and scrolling stay smooth with thousands of games.
Game Pass and Xbox library artwork is now sized to the tile, and the virtual keyboard got clearer icons.
Launching a game no longer freezes Shift while the store app starts, and opening Steam store details in the catalog, the Store app list in Add app, or play time no longer stalls the menus.
Sign-ins for Epic, Xbox and GOG are now stored encrypted for your Windows account. You stay signed in after updating.
Tighter security: Shift’s interface runs only its own code and can read only image and video files from your drives.
The log file is now capped at 1 MB.

Fixed controller input: nothing happening after the handheld woke from a long sleep, buttons staying pressed after a controller was unplugged, and the virtual keyboard typing by itself while a button was held.
Fixed dates and numbers not following the Windows regional format.
Fixed the launch screen missing a game’s live player count and the launch popup being cut off in the side-by-side layout.
Fixed Game Menu > Open game folder opening Explorer without focus, and the Game Menu header keeping the old logo after you changed it.
Fixed saving settings causing a short stall.
Fixed Epic games not starting while the Epic launcher was closed, also when Shift runs as administrator, and the Epic Games Store tile in Tools doing nothing.
Fixed Battle.net games not starting while the Battle.net app was closed, and games staying behind the Battle.net window.
Fixed Settings in Tools bringing up the Microsoft Store instead, after both had been opened.
Fixed play time and per-game settings like HDR being skipped for Steam games started through an account switch.
Fixed backgrounds not showing for files in a folder with an apostrophe in its name.
Several other bug fixes, performance improvements, and UI polish.

*Le Supporter Pack*, c’est un achat unique et optionnel, sans abonnement, qui débloque des fonctions en plus et aide à financer le développement.

Ce que tu obtiens :
- Des onglets promos dans les catalogues des stores, dont la bibliothèque PC Game Pass
- Un calendrier des sorties pour Steam, Epic et Game Pass
- De nouveaux thèmes, à commencer par Wall, plus tous ceux qui suivront
- Un thème différent pour chaque catalogue
- Plus de couleurs de focus pour les vignettes et les menus
- Un raccourci manette pour revenir sur Shift depuis un jeu ou le bureau
- Les nouveaux bonus au fur et à mesure, sans supplément

*Thème Wall* (Supporter Pack). Un mur de jaquettes en plein écran, incliné en 3D, une rangée par onglet, chaque rangée qui défile toute seule.
2 types d’effet et une option pour le rendre infini à la verticale. Règle-le comme tu veux.

Ta propre bibliothèque Xbox (l’onglet Pas installés) reste gratuite, et rien de ce que tu as réglé n’est supprimé : débloquer remet tout comme avant.
fr.Added Open/install in EA app button for: Ajout du bouton Ouvrir/installer dans l’app EA pour les jeux EA Play du catalogue Game Pass.

fr.Sign-ins for Epic, Xbox and GOG are now: Les connexions Epic, Xbox et GOG sont maintenant stockées chiffrées pour ton compte Windows. Tu restes connecté après la mise à jour.
fr.Tighter security: Shift’s interface runs: Sécurité renforcée : l’interface de Shift n’exécute que son propre code et ne peut lire que les images et vidéos de tes disques.
Le fichier de log est maintenant limité à 1 Mo.
fr.Fixed controller input: nothing happenin: Corrigé côté manette : plus rien ne répondait après une longue veille de la console, des boutons restaient enfoncés après avoir débranché une manette, et le clavier virtuel tapait tout seul quand un bouton était maintenu.
fr.Fixed dates and numbers not following th: Corrigé : les dates et nombres qui ne suivaient pas le format régional de Windows.
fr.Fixed the launch screen missing a game’s: Corrigé : le nombre de joueurs en direct qui manquait sur l’écran de lancement, et la fenêtre de lancement coupée dans la disposition côte à côte.
fr.Fixed Game Menu > Open game folder openi: Corrigé : Menu du jeu > Ouvrir le dossier du jeu qui ouvrait l’Explorateur sans le focus, et l’en-tête du menu du jeu qui gardait l’ancien logo après modification.
fr.Fixed saving settings causing a short st: Corrigé : un petit blocage à l’enregistrement des réglages.
fr.Fixed Epic games not starting while the: Corrigé : les jeux Epic qui ne démarraient pas quand le launcher Epic était fermé, y compris avec Shift en admin, et la vignette Epic Games Store dans Outils qui ne faisait rien.
fr.Fixed Battle.net games not starting whil: Corrigé : les jeux Battle.net qui ne démarraient pas quand l’app Battle.net était fermée, et les jeux qui restaient derrière la fenêtre Battle.net.
fr.Fixed Settings in Tools bringing up the: Corrigé : Paramètres dans Outils qui ouvrait le Microsoft Store à la place, une fois les deux ouverts.
fr.Fixed play time and per-game settings li: Corrigé : le temps de jeu et les réglages par jeu comme le HDR ignorés pour les jeux Steam lancés via un changement de compte.
fr.Fixed backgrounds not showing for files: Corrigé : les fonds qui ne s’affichaient pas pour les fichiers d’un dossier avec une apostrophe dans le nom.
fr.Several other bug fixes, performance imp: Plein d’autres correctifs, optimisations et finitions dans l’interface.

id.*The Supporter Pack* is an optional one-:
*Supporter Pack* itu pembelian sekali bayar yang opsional, tanpa langganan, buat buka fitur tambahan sekaligus bantu biaya pengembangan.

Yang kamu dapat:
- Tab promo di katalog store, termasuk library PC Game Pass
- Kalender rilis untuk Steam, Epic, dan Game Pass
- Tema baru, mulai dari Wall, plus semua tema yang nanti ditambahkan
- Tema beda untuk tiap katalog
- Lebih banyak warna fokus untuk tile grid dan menu
- Shortcut controller buat balik ke Shift dari game atau desktop
- fitur-fitur ekslusif di update yang akan datang, tanpa biaya tambahan

Lihat game yang bakal rilis di Steam dan Epic, dikelompokkan per minggu, bulan, atau tahun, lengkap dengan peringkat paling dinanti di Steam, badge Early Access dan Free to Play, plus trailer singkat game yang lagi difokus.
id.*Wall theme* (Supporter Pack). A full-sc:
*Tema Wall* (Supporter Pack). Dinding cover fullscreen yang miring ke belakang dalam 3D, satu baris per tab, tiap baris scroll sendiri.
Ada 2 jenis efek dan opsi biar scroll vertikalnya nggak ada ujungnya. Atur sesukamu.

id.*Automatic updates* for the GitHub versi: *Update otomatis* untuk versi GitHub. Matiin download-nya atau cek manual di Pengaturan > Info > Update software. Versi Microsoft Store tetap update lewat Store.
